source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "សណ្តែកសៀង (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក)" [Soybean (local varieties)], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text: Harvest guidance closes the leaflet: farmers are told to watch for the crop's maturity signs (pods and leaves turning from green to yellow-brown and drying) and to harvest promptly once mature to avoid pod shattering and seed loss in the field.
